name: worktrace
description: A persistent file tree and timeline of the files Claude reads, searches and changes, with summaries and exact diffs.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: When to ask the session's model for two-sentence file summaries: on-select (when you open a file), or off (factual summaries only).

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model alias or id used for summaries, through the session's own sign-in.

storeSensitive.title: Store sensitive file contents
storeSensitive.description: Keep snapshots of files that look like credentials (.env, keys, secrets). Off by default: only hashes and sizes are kept.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: emoji (📁 📄) or ascii (+ -) icons in the tree.
